performanceLimits: Native mode regression comparison; not a GOST-vs-nft throughput contest.

CPU percent is Agent-process CPU, excludes its GOST child and kernel/endpoint work.
Controller CPU0, Agent/worker CPU1, target CPU2, client CPU3; softirq placement is not confined to Agent CPU.
